other_mijikenda: Duruma, Giriama: same name (Pakia App. VI)

teaser.en: A climber with thick, smooth, bright green stems that stay green for years, and that has a reputation as a poisonous plant.
teaser.sw: Mtambaa wenye mashina manene, laini, ya kijani angavu yanayobaki kijani kwa miaka mingi, na unaojulikana kuwa mmea wenye sumu.

summary.en: Gore is a big climber of the passion-flower family, recognised by its smooth green stems and lobed leaves. The name is shared with Duruma and Giriama.
summary.sw: Gore ni mtambaa mkubwa wa familia ya mkarakara (passion-flower), unaotambulika kwa mashina yake laini ya kijani na majani yenye mapande. Jina hili linashirikiwa na Kiduruma na Kigiriama.

about.en: Gore is a vigorous climber that clambers over trees and thicket with the help of tendrils. Its most striking feature is the stem, which stays smooth and green, often with a bluish bloom, even when it is as thick as an arm. The leaves are usually three-lobed. The small greenish flowers are followed by round capsules that split open to show the seeds. Digo people identify it by its leaves and stem together.
about.sw: Gore ni mtambaa wenye nguvu unaopanda juu ya miti na vichaka vizito kwa msaada wa vitete-shikizi (tendrils). Sifa yake inayovutia zaidi ni shina, ambalo hubaki laini na la kijani, mara nyingi likiwa na weupe wa samawati juu yake, hata likiwa nene kama mkono. Majani kwa kawaida yana mapande matatu. Maua madogo ya kijani hufuatwa na vibuyu vya mviringo vinavyopasuka kuonyesha mbegu. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani na shina lake kwa pamoja.

where.en: It grows in coastal forest, forest edges and thicket, climbing high into the trees.
where.sw: Hukua katika misitu ya pwani, pembezoni mwa misitu na vichakani, ukipanda juu sana mitini.

uses.en: Pakia records no use for it among the Digo. Across eastern and southern Africa, *Adenia gummifera* is known as a strongly poisonous plant, even though healers there use small amounts of it in traditional remedies.
uses.sw: Pakia haripoti matumizi yoyote miongoni mwa Wadigo. Katika Afrika Mashariki na Kusini, *Adenia gummifera* unajulikana kuwa mmea wenye sumu kali, ingawa waganga huko hutumia kiasi kidogo chake katika dawa za jadi.

names.en: Digo: *gore*. Pakia records the same name in Duruma and Giriama and gives no meaning for it. In southern Africa it is called snake climber or green-stem. Scientists call it *Adenia gummifera*. Its relative *Adenia kirkii* is *mtsotsone*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *gore*. Pakia anarekodi jina hilohilo kwa Kiduruma na Kigiriama na hatoi maana yake. Kusini mwa Afrika unaitwa *snake climber* au *green-stem*. Wanasayansi huuita *Adenia gummifera*. Ndugu yake *Adenia kirkii* ni *mtsotsone*.

reason.en: Another forest climber of the passion-flower family
reason.sw: Mtambaa mwingine wa msituni wa familia ya mkarakara

reason.en: Passion fruit, a cultivated member of the same family
reason.sw: Karakara, mmea wa kupandwa wa familia ileile
